name: Lightning, Americas and Pacific (NOAA nowCOAST strike density)
description: Where lightning is striking: NOAA's 15-minute lightning strike density on an 8 km grid from the western Pacific across the Americas to 0° (25° S to 80° N), from NOAA nowCOAST as a raster overlay, about 15 minutes behind. Each poll republishes the newest frame. A density NOAA derives from the Vaisala NLDN and GLD360 ground networks and releases for public distribution; not individual strikes, and not global.

attribution.text: Lightning: NOAA/NWS nowCOAST, derived from Vaisala NLDN/GLD360
